data_card.purpose: Local teaching of dated policy answers, own-order reads and observable service operations.
data_card.people_and_credentials: Fictional principals and public placeholder keys only. No personal data or real merchant orders.
data_card.versions: Retain original five cards/nine queries and both 600/750 source intervals; never overwrite old evaluation data to remove a miss.
data_card.localization: Textbook pages, bilingual diagram JSON and data/knowledge-assistant/service-content-v1.json are explicit content resources.
data_card.feedback: At most 100 categorical reports, no free text; quarantine before trusted local maintainer review; separate minimized regression and source rationale.

retention.jobs: At most 100 in memory; completed eviction, shutdown clears; not durable request history.
retention.cache: At most 64 in memory; scoped TTL boundary plus periodic cleanup; subject deletion supported.
retention.feedback: Logical expiry at seven days; physical sweep approximately once per second; subject deletion and shutdown clear.
retention.monitor: At most 1000 rows; truncated window marked incomplete; shutdown clears.
retention.diagnostics: No question/result/token/principal; approximate 1 MB rotation with one previous file; no time-based deletion; operator owns retained state directory.
retention.public_evidence: Separate intentionally synthetic immutable artifacts; not a sample of real user traffic.

data_card.deletion_limit: Cache and feedback subject deletion is not a complete production erasure workflow across jobs, diagnostics, exports and backups.
data_card.representativeness: Small authored cases; no population, adaptive attacker or independent annotator diversity estimate.

system_card.default_backend: local-extractive-v1, no neural model calls; dated BM25 evidence plus schema/support/Skill verification.

neural_model.reason: Not used on default service path; lexical tokenization and floating-point recipe are versioned separately.

system_card.selection: Retained failed Mini GPT candidates; historical optional Qwen3 adapter and rejected automatic judge do not become service quality claims.
system_card.authority: Host fixture credentials determine tenant/user/scopes. Input cannot choose tenant. Web service and separate MCP teaching transport are read-only.
system_card.state: Service jobs and release pointers are in memory. Tenant order store is local SQLite. Earlier approved-write CLI has durable intent/approval/receipt recovery and is not exposed over HTTP.
system_card.operations: Manifest-bound gate, configuration-only local canary/rollback, traces, assigned 95% SLO and explicitly bounded monitor.
system_card.ux: Visible associated labels, focus, concise polite statuses, final checked source quotation, local clear/undo and unsent handoff. No full WCAG conformance claim.
known_failures: Stale-date candidate fails six of ten release presentations.
An in-flight stale snapshot survives rollback.
